about_short_description.short_description: CATRION is a hospitality and services company that provides culinary, catering, and integrated support services.

product.name: In-Flight Catering
product.description: Provision of meals and food services to airline passengers during flights, focusing on menu design, food safety, and passenger satisfaction.

product.name: Airport Lounges
product.description: Management and operation of airport lounges providing meals, amenities, and services to travelers in a comfortable environment.

product.name: Integrated Hospitality and Facilities Management
product.description: Comprehensive catering and facilities management services across various industries including healthcare, oil, gas, manufacturing, and railways.

product.name: Hajj and Umrah Catering Services
product.description: Production and delivery of fresh and frozen meals for pilgrims during Hajj and Umrah, adhering to food safety and nutritional standards.

product.name: Giga Projects Services
product.description: Provision of integrated services including technical maintenance, food service, and industrial laundry for large-scale development projects.

product.name: Commercial Laundry Services
product.description: Cleaning and maintenance of uniforms, linens, and specialized textiles for airlines, hotels, hospitals, and industrial clients.
